nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bạn bè · bài tự soạn
L: A
Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Chloe.
B
Hey, nice to meet you. I'm Dan. This is my first week here.
A
Welcome! Where are you from, Dan?
B
I grew up in Da Nang, but I moved here for work.
A
Cool! What do you like doing in your free time?
B
I'm into photography, and I play guitar a little.
A
No kidding! I love taking photos too.
B
We should go shooting together some time.
A
Definitely. Do you want to grab a drink after class?
B
Sure, I'd love to. Lead the way!

exq.why: “I grew up in Da Nang” = lớn lên ở Đà Nẵng.
“I moved here for work.” = chuyển tới đây vì công việc.

exq.q: What hobby do both Chloe and Dan share?
exq.why: Dan: “I'm into photography”; Chloe: “I love taking photos too.”

exq.q: What does Chloe suggest at the end?
w: Taking a photo walk on Sunday
exq.why: “Do you want to grab a drink after class?” = rủ đi uống sau giờ học.
